inductive Tensor : Type where
  | mk : Array Float → Tensor

def Tensor.data : Tensor → Array Float
  | Tensor.mk arr => arr

inductive OFTB : Type where
  | mk : Float → Nat → OFTB

def OFTB.fractal_scale : OFTB → Float
  | OFTB.mk fs _ => fs

def OFTB.dim : OFTB → Nat
  | OFTB.mk _ d => d

def OFTB.init (d : Nat) : OFTB :=
  OFTB.mk 0.70710678 d

def floatHalf : Float := 0.5

def arraySetRange (arr : Array Float) (start : Nat) (len : Nat) (f : Nat → Float → Float) : Array Float :=
  Nat.rec
    arr
    (fun i ih =>
      let idx := start + i
      Nat.casesOn (Nat.decLt idx arr.size)
        ih
        (fun _ => ih.set ⟨idx, by exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (by exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.le_refl _)) (by exact Nat.le_refl _)⟩ (f i (ih.get ⟨idx, by exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (by exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.le_refl _)) (by exact Nat.le_refl _)⟩))))
    len

def arrayCopyRange (src : Array Float) (startSrc : Nat) (len : Nat) : Array Float :=
  Nat.rec
    (Array.mkEmpty len)
    (fun i ih =>
      let idx := startSrc + i
      Nat.casesOn (Nat.decLt idx src.size)
        ih
        (fun _ => ih.push (src.get ⟨idx, by exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (by exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.le_refl _)) (by exact Nat.le_refl _)⟩)))
    len

def applyForwardRange (data : Array Float) (half : Nat) (fs : Float) : Array Float :=
  let applyX1 : Array Float :=
    Nat.rec
      data
      (fun i ih =>
        let idx1 := i
        let idx2 := half + i
        Nat.casesOn (Nat.decLt idx1 ih.size)
          ih
          (fun hlt1 =>
            Nat.casesOn (Nat.decLt idx2 ih.size)
              ih
              (fun hlt2 =>
                let v1 := ih.get ⟨idx1, hlt1⟩
                let v2 := ih.get ⟨idx2, hlt2⟩
                ih.set ⟨idx1, hlt1⟩ (v1 + v2 * fs))))
      half
  applyX1

def applyForwardX2WithBuf (data : Array Float) (half : Nat) (buf : Array Float) (fs : Float) : Array Float :=
  Nat.rec
    data
    (fun i ih =>
      let idx2 := half + i
      Nat.casesOn (Nat.decLt idx2 ih.size)
        ih
        (fun hlt2 =>
          Nat.casesOn (Nat.decLt i buf.size)
            ih
            (fun hltb =>
              let v2 := ih.get ⟨idx2, hlt2⟩
              let vb := buf.get ⟨i, hltb⟩
              ih.set ⟨idx2, hlt2⟩ (v2 + vb * fs * floatHalf))))
    half

def OFTB.forwardInPlace (self : OFTB) (t : Tensor) : Tensor :=
  let arr := Tensor.data t
  let half := OFTB.dim self
  let fs := OFTB.fractal_scale self
  Nat.casesOn (Nat.decLt arr.size (half * 2))
    (Nat.casesOn (Nat.decLt 16384 half)
      (let buf := arrayCopyRange arr 0 half
       let arr2 := applyForwardRange arr half fs
       let arr3 := applyForwardX2WithBuf arr2 half buf fs
       Tensor.mk arr3)
      (fun _ => t))
    (fun _ => t)

def applyBackwardG2 (data : Array Float) (half : Nat) (buf : Array Float) (fs : Float) : Array Float :=
  Nat.rec
    data
    (fun i ih =>
      let idx1 := i
      let idx2 := half + i
      Nat.casesOn (Nat.decLt idx2 ih.size)
        ih
        (fun hlt2 =>
          Nat.casesOn (Nat.decLt idx1 ih.size)
            ih
            (fun hlt1 =>
              let v2 := ih.get ⟨idx2, hlt2⟩
              let v1 := ih.get ⟨idx1, hlt1⟩
              ih.set ⟨idx2, hlt2⟩ (v2 + v1 * fs))))
    half

def applyBackwardG1WithBuf (data : Array Float) (half : Nat) (buf : Array Float) (fs : Float) : Array Float :=
  Nat.rec
    data
    (fun i ih =>
      let idx1 := i
      Nat.casesOn (Nat.decLt idx1 ih.size)
        ih
        (fun hlt1 =>
          Nat.casesOn (Nat.decLt i buf.size)
            ih
            (fun hltb =>
              let v1 := ih.get ⟨idx1, hlt1⟩
              let vb := buf.get ⟨i, hltb⟩
              ih.set ⟨idx1, hlt1⟩ (v1 + vb * fs * floatHalf))))
    half

def OFTB.backwardInPlace (self : OFTB) (grad : Array Float) : Array Float :=
  let half := OFTB.dim self
  let fs := OFTB.fractal_scale self
  Nat.casesOn (Nat.decLt grad.size (half * 2))
    (Nat.casesOn (Nat.decLt 16384 half)
      (let buf := arrayCopyRange grad half half
       let grad2 := applyBackwardG2 grad half buf fs
       let grad3 := applyBackwardG1WithBuf grad2 half buf fs

      (fun _ => grad))
    (fun _ => grad)

inductive Tensor : Type where
  | mk : Array Float → Tensor

def Tensor.data : Tensor → Array Float
  | Tensor.mk arr => arr

inductive OFTB : Type where
  | mk : Float → Nat → OFTB

def OFTB.fractal_scale : OFTB → Float
  | OFTB.mk fs _ => fs

def OFTB.dim : OFTB → Nat
  | OFTB.mk _ d => d

def floatHalf : Float := 0.5

def OFTB.init (d : Nat) : OFTB :=
  OFTB.mk 0.70710678 d

def arrayCopyRange (src : Array Float) (startSrc : Nat) (len : Nat) : Array Float :=
  Nat.rec
    (Array.mkEmpty len)
    (fun i ih =>
      let idx := startSrc + i
      Nat.casesOn (Nat.decLt idx src.size)
        ih
        (fun _ => ih.push (src.get ⟨idx, Nat.lt_of_succ_le (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.le_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_self i) (Nat.le_add_left i startSrc)))⟩)))
    len

def arraySetIdx (arr : Array Float) (idx : Nat) (v : Float) (h : idx < arr.size) : Array Float :=
  arr.set ⟨idx, h⟩ v

def applyForwardX1Loop (arr : Array Float) (half : Nat) (fs : Float)
    (hSize : half * 2 ≤ arr.size) : Array Float :=
  Nat.rec
    arr
    (fun i ih =>
      let idx1 := i
      let idx2 := half + i
      Nat.casesOn (Nat.decLt i half)
        ih
        (fun hlt =>
          let h1 : idx1 < ih.size := Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hlt (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right half (Nat.zero_lt_succ 1)) hSize)
          let h2 : idx2 < ih.size := Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.add_lt_add_left hlt half) (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_refl _) hSize)
          let v1 := ih.get ⟨idx1, h1⟩
          let v2 := ih.get ⟨idx2, h2⟩
          ih.set ⟨idx1, h1⟩ (v1 + v2 * fs)))
    half

def applyForwardX2Loop (arr : Array Float) (half : Nat) (buf : Array Float) (fs : Float)
    (hSize : half * 2 ≤ arr.size) (hBuf : half ≤ buf.size) : Array Float :=
  Nat.rec
    arr
    (fun i ih =>
      let idx2 := half + i
      Nat.casesOn (Nat.decLt i half)
        ih
        (fun hlt =>
          let h2 : idx2 < ih.size := Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.add_lt_add_left hlt half) (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_refl _) hSize)
          let hb : i < buf.size := Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hlt hBuf
          let v2 := ih.get ⟨idx2, h2⟩
          let vb := buf.get ⟨i, hb⟩
          ih.set ⟨idx2, h2⟩ (v2 + vb * fs * floatHalf)))
    half

def OFTB.forwardInPlace (self : OFTB) (t : Tensor) : Tensor :=
  let arr := Tensor.data t
  let half := OFTB.dim self
  let fs := OFTB.fractal_scale self
  Nat.casesOn (Nat.decLt (half * 2) arr.size)
    t
    (fun hlt =>
      Nat.casesOn (Nat.decLt 16384 half)
        t
        (fun _ =>
          let hSize : half * 2 ≤ arr.size := Nat.le_of_lt hlt
          let buf := arrayCopyRange arr 0 half
          let hBuf : half ≤ buf.size := Nat.le_refl half
          let arr2 := applyForwardX1Loop arr half fs hSize
          let hSize2 : half * 2 ≤ arr2.size := hSize
          let arr3 := applyForwardX2Loop arr2 half buf fs hSize2 hBuf
          Tensor.mk arr3))

  Nat.rec
    arr
    (fun i ih =>
      let idx1 := i
      let idx2 := half + i

          let v2 := ih.get ⟨idx2, h2⟩
          let v1 := ih.get ⟨idx1, h1⟩
          ih.set ⟨idx2, h2⟩ (v2 + v1 * fs)))
    half

  let half := OFTB.dim self
  let fs := OFTB.fractal_scale self

          let buf := arrayCopyRange grad half half
          let hBuf : half ≤ buf.size := Nat.le_refl half
          let grad2 := applyBackwardG2Loop grad half fs hSize
          let hSize2 : half * 2 ≤ grad2.size := hSize
          let grad3 := applyBackwardG1Loop grad2 half buf fs hSize2 hBuf

            (Nat.le_add_right half n)

              (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right half (Nat.zero_lt_succ 1)) hSize))
            (Nat.lt_succ_self n)

            afterStep.get ⟨half + k, _⟩ =
            arr.get ⟨half + k, _⟩ + arr.get ⟨k, _⟩ * fs) heq.symm)

    hi

def applyBackwardG1Loop (arr : Array Float) (half : Nat) (buf : Array Float) (fs : Float)

            hSize)

        Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_self i) hBuf
      ih.set ⟨i, h1⟩ (ih.get ⟨i, h1⟩ + buf.get ⟨i, hb⟩ * fs * floatHalf))

        Eq.mpr

            ⟨i, Eq.mpr (congrArg (fun s => i < s) (Array.size_set prev ⟨n, h1n⟩ _))

def OFTB.forwardInPlace (self : OFTB) (t : Tensor) : Tensor :=
  let arr := Tensor.data t
  let half := OFTB.dim self
  let fs := OFTB.fractal_scale self
  match Nat.decLt (half * 2) arr.size with
  | Decidable.isFalse _ => t
  | Decidable.isTrue hlt =>
    match Nat.decLt 16384 half with
    | Decidable.isTrue _ => t
    | Decidable.isFalse _ =>
      let hSize : half * 2 ≤ arr.size := Nat.le_of_lt hlt
      let hcopy : 0 + half ≤ arr.size :=
        Nat.le_trans (Nat.zero_add half ▸ Nat.le_refl half)
          (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right half (Nat.zero_lt_succ 1)) hSize)
      let buf := arrayCopyRange arr 0 half
      let hBuf : half ≤ buf.size :=
        Eq.mpr (congrArg (fun s => half ≤ s) (arrayCopyRange_size arr 0 half hcopy))
          (Nat.le_refl half)
      let arr2 := applyForwardX1Loop arr half fs hSize
      let arr3 := applyForwardX2Loop arr2 half buf fs hSize hBuf
      Tensor.mk arr3
